title: Chapter 1304
text:
On the other side, Black Star Corps territory, Mechanical Life Civilization, Planet Apostle.

Planet Apostle was located in the central region of the Sigma Star System of the Flickering World. This was a gigantic planet, and its surface was filled with intersecting mechanical buildings. Giant structures could be found everywhere, and it was filled with industrial beauty.

In the many years of development, as the mother planet of the Mechanical Life Civilization, Planet Apostle had been modified multiple times. The Mechanical Life Civilization had hollowed out the entire planet and replaced most of the planet's materials with metal. It was almost completely mechanized, and the entire Planet Apostle was now a mobile galactic war fortress. As the population of the Mechanical Life Civilization grew exponentially, the size of the planet had been artificially expanded many times. It was originally an average-sized planet, but it was now a gigantic planet.

Four gigantic satellites surrounded Planet Apostle, and they were mainly used by the Mechanical Life Civilization to carry out galactic construction projects.

At this moment, a gigantic wormhole appeared beside one of the satellites, and a black mechanical army pulled a gigantic unknown mechanical body out like a swarm of hardworking ants.

Streams of light flew out from Planet Apostle and hovered not far away from the mechanical body. They were Psionic Prime and the other Apostle Weapons.

As Han Xiao's technology level improved, these Apostle Weapons also changed from bird guns to cannons. They took the initiative to upgrade their equipment time and time again, and their appearance changed significantly. If they looked like poor commoners a few decades ago, they now looked like tycoons.

At this moment, a light flashed beside Psionic Prime, and Han Xiao's figure teleported over. The Apostle Weapons had already received the news, and they all bowed.

Psionic Prime's electronic eyes flickered, and a green virtual bubble with a curious expression appeared above his head. He asked with an emotionless voice, "What's the matter?

With an emotionless voice, he asked, "Lord, what is this?"

"A mechanical wreckage that contains unknown technology. It's for my research. I'll leave it with you for now. I don't want it to be seen by too many people, so it's not suitable to keep it in the Black Star Palace," Han Xiao replied.

Psionic Prime nodded. "I'll arrange for people to build a secret research facility to store this mechanical body. Do you want to start the project now?"

"Hmm, let's set up a file. From now on, this big guy's serial number will be SWY-001."

Han Xiao casually came up with a code name. SWY didn't have any special meaning. He just casually used the Pinyin acronym for "what the hell". He felt that the meaning of this code name was very clear. If he encountered any unknown things in the future, he would use this code name series. It would be easy to understand at a glance.

While the construction team was transporting SWY-001, Han Xiao turned around to look at the mechanical life civilization and nodded.

After seventy to eighty years of development, the mechanical life civilization, with the resources provided by the army, had greatly expanded in the Sigma Star System, demonstrating their interstellar industrial level development and achieving self-sufficiency. Their population was booming, and they had become one of Han Xiao's main sources of soldiers.

Even without the bonus of his Mechanical Force, the current mechanical life civilization was more than enough to deal with an ordinary Star System civilization. After all, the greatest advantage of a mechanical civilization was the high efficiency of resource allocation, the high uniformity of thinking, the almost zero physiological and entertainment needs, and all the citizens were soldiers. However, they would not encounter all kinds of negative social problems like ordinary civilizations. It could be said that the industrial system of a mechanical civilization was born for war.

Han Xiao could not help but think of the Black Spirit Race that was developing in the Edni Star System next door. They also had a hive mind that efficiently allocated resources. Through their amazing collective learning ability, they quickly digested the technology tree and deduced new technological directions. They were also developing rapidly and had already started colonizing the galaxy, transforming into a Star System civilization.

Because of the strong collective learning ability of the mental network, the Black Spirit Race had nurtured a large number of scientists in basic subjects. Currently, they had already sent a large number of talents to the logistics department and the Super Academy.

However, due to their differences, the Black Spirit Race took a different path and did not become a war machine like a mechanical civilization. Instead, they developed a new culture. In comparison, the Black Spirit Race was a civilization recognized by the galactic society.

Both civilizations were developing rapidly. With these two cards in hand, the Black Star Corps' ability to be self-sufficient was still very outstanding. Han Xiao was quite satisfied with the development of both civilizations. It only took them a few decades to catch up to the standard of a Star System civilization, which was already extremely shocking.

Although the Black Star Corps had spared no effort in providing resources and technical support, the Blue Star, which had the same treatment, was still far from a Star System civilization.

"There's really no harm without comparison. The Blue Star probably doesn't have any other good points other than their outstanding talents and location …"

While he was lamenting, the engineering team finally transported SWY-001 over, and the directional wormhole shrank and disappeared.

Han Xiao calmed himself down and ordered his mechanical army to quickly build a research lab around SWY-001's body.

Galactic Engineering was extremely efficient. Not long after, the prototype of an enormous research lab was built from scratch and enveloped SWY-001.

"Let me see what treasures you have …"

Han Xiao was in a good mood. He walked into the research area, summoned all kinds of research equipment, and immediately immersed himself in the reverse-engineering research.

His first step was to look for SWY-001's memory module. Very soon, he found the damaged memory chip module and the enormous biological organ with brain tissue structure. However, be it mechanical technology or biological technology, they were all within the scope of his technology.

Han Xiao ordered his mechanical assistants to take off the memory chip module, put it into a data analysis device, and started reading the data inside. At the same time, he ordered another batch of assistants to take out a set of needle-like cables and insert them into the pale white brain fluid of the biological organ. The cables were automatically attached to the memory synapses and analyzed the memory information stored inside.

Very soon, reports were displayed on the screen one after another. Due to the fusion, the memory module seemed to contain the life experiences of all the Mechanics who sacrificed themselves. However, SWY-001's memory file was severely damaged and contained a large amount of redundant information, so the process of analyzing and piecing it together was rather slow.

Han Xiao had a few research goals. One of them was to directly obtain the blueprint knowledge of these Mechanics by digging into the memory module. If he succeeded, he would save a lot of time and not have to reverse engineer every part of SWY-001's body.

After placing the device to continue analyzing the memory, Han Xiao specifically found the AI control module. There was a high chance that the logs of all the functions of the body were stored inside. It was like a manual to him.

However, the AI control module was protected by a virtual firewall and used the basic code of this unknown civilization. It was different from the Virtual Technology of the Galactic Society and required basic analysis, just like the Virtual Mutiny Virus of the Intelligent Plague.

This was not difficult for the current Han Xiao, but it would take some time.

According to SWY-001's characteristics, the nature of its consciousness was very likely to be double. One was the soul consciousness sleeping in the creature's brain, and the other was the AI consciousness stored in the mechanical memory device. It was a combination of a normal life form and a mechanical life form. Therefore, as long as he could break through the firewall and rewrite the AI program, there was a high chance that he could achieve the effect of brainwashing.

After all, Han Xiao had also mastered the Felon technology, so he was not unfamiliar with this kind of thought modification.

You have gained some insights from your current research.

+ 16.4% Unique Talent Research Progress

Current Progress: 61.1%

"He triggered another Exclusive Skill? Today is really my lucky day! "

Han Xiao paused for a moment, and his eyes sparkled.

In the past few decades, he had only triggered the Unique Talent three times. Now, the progress of his Unique Talent had finally improved again. If this notification had not popped up, he would have almost forgotten about it.

During the version update, his EXP reserve was a little tight, so Han Xiao did not use his Awakening Points to exchange for talent progress. However, now that the players had returned, it was not impossible to consider this option.

However, Promotion was his current priority, so Han Xiao did not plan to use his EXP recklessly. He planned to use the remaining EXP to exchange for Awakening Points after he met the requirements for Promotion.

After all, he did not know what the threshold for a higher level was, so he had already decided to increase his Energy Rank as much as possible before Promotion. The Void God's Trait Transformation was one of the reasons, but having another Unique Talent was not bad either.

…

After obtaining SWY-001, Han Xiao's research focus changed. He spent most of his time analyzing SWY-001 in the research institute, talking to the Holy Covenant members one by one, convincing a group of them, and waiting for the right time to come out.

In the outside world, the three Universal Civilizations and the Beyond Grade A Association did not continue to have conflicts on the surface, but the battle in the black market was getting more and more intense. The players who took over the black market in different areas faced different challenges. Most of them worked together to overcome the difficulties, slowly increasing the progress of the black market integration.

Endless Nebula, Didora Star System, a certain transit station planet …

Kacha … Kacha …

Footsteps that sounded like they were stepping on broken glass echoed in the dim room.

The Army Commander's Big PP leaned against the wall, covered in wounds. There was already a pool of blood under his body, and he was in a heavily injured and stiff state, unable to move. He could only stare in the direction of the footsteps with his eyes wide open.

Very soon, the sound of footsteps gradually approached. A thick silhouette gradually became clearer under the dim light. He was wearing a black and red mechanical armor, holding a blood-red mechanical axe in his hand. Blood was dripping down from the axe.

Behind him was a messy scene. Corpses were scattered all over the ground, blood flowing everywhere. The walls were full of bullet holes, and a large number of bullet casings and metal fragments were scattered on the ground. It looked like a fierce battle had taken place here.

This was a black market base that had been taken over by the Army Commander's Big PP not long ago, and it was gradually getting on the right track.

However, today, a person came knocking on the door and destroyed this black market channel by himself. He killed everyone in the base, leaving only the army commander, Big J. Ji, alive. He was killed many times and used up all of his resurrection chances. He had no power to fight back.

This was because the enemy was a Calamity Grade!

The mechanical suit warrior stopped in front of the Army Commander's Big PP, opened his helmet, and revealed a brown scaled face that looked like a pangolin in human form.

He said calmly, "You're the only one left …"

"Dafis, we have no grudges in the past. Why are you doing this to us? Did you accept the employment of the affiliated organizations of the three Universal Civilizations? "

The Army Commander's Big PP clenched his teeth.

After operating the black market here for a while, he had some understanding of the organizations around here. This guy who looked like a pangolin in human form was the leader of a well-known civilian armed organization in this Star System, a Calamity Grade Mechanical Pugilist!

Hearing this, Dafis let out a short laugh with a hint of mockery.

"Do I need to inform you when I'm going to kill you?"

"Don't be arrogant! You ruined my mission. I'll remember you. Just you wait! "The Army Commander's Big PP clenched his teeth and threatened.

"What, a Grade B Super wants to take revenge on me? Just because you're an Immortal? "

Dafis's face was cold, unmoved.

Then, he slowly raised the heavy axe in his hand and said coldly, "You're too weak.

It's useless no matter how many times you come … It's your honor to die in my hands. "

As soon as he said that, the heavy axe fell, and blood splattered everywhere.

This time, the Army Commander's Big PP did not revive. He had already used up all six days of revival chances.

Seeing this, Dafis turned around and left without even looking back, leaving behind a ground full of corpses.

The Army Commander's Big PP was ejected from his body and could not go online for a day. He could only log into the forums.

"Damn it, you forced me to do this!"

The Army Commander's Big PP was furious.

The black market that he had taken over with much difficulty was destroyed by a Calamity Grade Dimensional Reduction. His mission was considered a failure, so he could only go to another area and start over.

The more he thought about it, the angrier he got. The more he thought about it, the angrier he got!

He was so angry that he clenched his teeth and opened the built-in group chat function of the forums. He sent a message in the army channel.

"My black market was destroyed by someone. The other party is a Calamity Grade! Brothers, we've been quiet for so long. Are you interested in opening a boss and making the Army Commander proud? I'm willing to pay! "

There was a moment of silence in the channel. Then, messages flooded the screen like a waterfall. In summary, there was only one sentence:

Who was it? Where was it? When was it? How much was it?

A cloud-piercing arrow, and thousands of soldiers came!
